transcript.text: You have been working as a Trade Assistant at your family textile firm since 2024. Can you describe your key daily responsibilities?

For the last two years I have worked in our family's textile trading firm in Surat. I handle orders from about 25 regular retailers across Gujarat and Rajasthan. I started a WhatsApp catalogue with a simple order sheet, and repeat orders went up from 12 to 18 a month. I also follow up on payments. I want an MBA because I learned the trade from my father, but I don't have a method for planning inventory or pricing.
You mentioned starting a WhatsApp catalogue and order sheet that increased repeat orders from 12 to 18 a month. Can you explain how you came up with this idea and what steps you took to implement it?
transcript.anchor_quote: I started a WhatsApp catalogue with a simple order sheet, and repeat orders went up from 12 to 18 a month

transcript.text: I can't share our turnover, margins or the names of our big buyers. That is the family's private information, so I can describe my own tasks only.
You mentioned starting a WhatsApp catalogue with a simple order sheet that increased repeat orders. Could you describe your role specifically in creating and maintaining this catalogue system?
transcript.anchor_quote: I started a WhatsApp catalogue with a simple order sheet, and repeat orders went up from 12 to 18 a month

transcript.text: Our business is in a very dynamic and competitive sector. We continuously focus on customer satisfaction and process excellence, and I try to bring a modern outlook to the traditional business.

You mentioned trying to bring a modern outlook to the traditional business. Can you give an example of a specific change or innovation you introduced to improve customer satisfaction or process excellence?
transcript.anchor_quote: I try to bring a modern outlook to the traditional business

transcript.text: Overdue accounts came down from 9 to 5, but I did that alone as the business owner. Actually my father has retired and I have been running the firm entirely.

You mentioned running the firm entirely since your father retired and reducing overdue accounts from 9 to 5 on your own. What strategies or steps did you take to achieve this improvement in managing payments?
You are assuming that a family business does not give real responsibility. I disagree. I speak to retailers daily and I answer for my orders. It is not a lesser job than working in a company.

feedback.summary: The candidate demonstrates practical responsibility in their family textile trading business, taking ownership of order management and payment follow-ups. They show initiative by introducing the WhatsApp catalogue that improved repeat orders and have taken full operational control after the father's retirement. The motivation for MBA is grounded in the need to learn professional methods for planning and pricing. However, clearer explanations of their direct personal contributions to innovations and methods for improvement would strengthen their narrative. More detailed examples of their problem-solving and reflection on lessons learned would enhance the interview.
